description: Simulates a Cyprus unit-linked life insurance policy and calculates tax and returns from executed withdrawals only. Requests above available funds are capped and flagged; self-funded surrender taxes are included in household cash flows and IRR. Use to model withdrawals from an existing Cyprus life-insurance policy. Require actual policy terms, tax rate, historical policy records and future premium/withdrawal projections; ask for missing items and never generate policy history. Amounts requested above available funds are limited to executed proceeds, and tax/return figures follow those executed cash flows. Forecast returns are assumptions and must be identified as such.

aumFee.description: Annual management fee as a percent of fund value.

brokerReturnRate.description: Annual return of the broker account, percent (used with useDifferentBrokerReturn).

capitalSumInsured.description: Death benefit / sum insured, EUR. Mortality cost applies to the amount at risk above the fund value.

contractStartYear.description: Calendar year the policy started. Partial surrenders are only tax-free from the 4th policy year.

gender.description: Used to look up mortality rates.

historicalData.description: Actual policy history; the last entry's endingBalance is the simulation's opening balance, and the 3/4-year lookbacks drive the safe limit.

premiumsPaid.description: EUR amount. Supply the actual value when applicable; use 0 only when confirmed to be zero.

withdrawalsMade.description: EUR amount. Supply the actual value when applicable; use 0 only when confirmed to be zero.

investmentReturn.description: Annual percentage value (e.g. 2.5 for 2.5%). Supply the actual rate unless the user accepts a stated modelling default. Expected annual return inside the policy.

monthlyFee.description: Fixed policy fee charged each month, EUR.

isSelfFunded.description: Premium funded by withdrawing from the policy itself; costs a 5% spread each month.

monthlyPremium.description: EUR amount. Supply the actual value when applicable; use 0 only when confirmed to be zero.

plannedWithdrawal.description: Withdrawal to attempt in this year (userInput scenario only).

reinvestWithdrawals.description: When true, net withdrawals are reinvested in a broker account and IRR is computed on combined wealth.

scenario.description: Which scenario to report as the primary result (default userInput). All three are always returned for comparison.

taxBracket.description: Marginal income tax rate applied to taxable surrender amounts and to premium relief, percent.

useDifferentBrokerReturn.description: Use brokerReturnRate instead of investmentReturn for the broker account.

name: simulate_life_insurance_flush
